labels.reason: Historical reviewer: 'In my experience' is a standard epistemic qualifier in Q&A, essay, and professional writing — it signals personal-evidence grounding, not bragging. 'As someone who has' is a standard credential citation ('As someone who has moved from the US...' / 'as someone who has raised children'). The rule conflates legitimate first-person grounding with braggadocio. None of the 28 samples actually boasts about an impressive credential — they are all ordinary experiential anchors.
